rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for being socially shy or reserved, especially around unfamiliar people.

example.english: I get shy whenever I see strangers.
example.traditional: 我見到陌生人就好怕醜。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gin3 dou2 mak6 saang1 jan4 zau6 hou2 paa3 cau2

rows.note: Choose this when “shy” means timid or easily frightened rather than socially reserved.

example.english: I'm shy and don't dare walk alone at night.
example.traditional: 我好膽小，夜晚唔敢自己行街。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 daam2 siu2 je6 maan5 m4 gam2 zi6 gei2 haang4 gaai1

rows.note: Use this count construction when something is short by A items, as in a shipment being two short.

example.english: This delivery is shy two items.
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 sung3 fo3 siu2 zo2 loeng5 gin6

rows.note: Use this when “shy of” means guarded or suspicious toward a person, situation, or risk.

example.traditional: 我對陌生人一向戒心重。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 mak6 saang1 jan4 jat1 hoeng3 gaai3 sam1 zung6
